document_title: UPI Transaction Failure and Auto-Reversal Policy
content:
[upi_payments] UPI Transaction Failure and Auto-Reversal Policy
When money is debited from the sender's bank account during a UPI transaction but the beneficiary does not receive the funds, NPCI guidelines provide automatic reversal. Most failed UPI transactions auto-reverse within T+1 business day and at most within 3 to 5 working days. If the reversal is not credited after 3 working days, the customer should raise a transaction dispute inside the UPI app under Transaction History using the 12-digit UTR or RRN reference number, or contact customer support to log a reconciliation ticket.

content:
[accounts] Video KYC Verification Policy and Document Requirements
Customers completing Video KYC must have their original physical PAN card ready, Aadhaar registered mobile number for OTP verification, a smartphone or camera device in a well-lit environment, and a blank white sheet with a dark pen for live signature capture. Video KYC verification sessions take approximately 2 to 5 minutes once connected with a KYC officer. Photocopied, laminated, or digital screenshots of the PAN card are not accepted under RBI KYC guidelines.

[ୟୁପିଆଇ ପେମେଣ୍ଟ ବିଫଳତା ଏବଂ ସ୍ୱୟଂଚାଳିତ ରିଫଣ୍ଡ ନିୟମାବଳୀ - UPI Refund Protocol in Odia]
ଯଦି ଆପଣଙ୍କ ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କ ଖାତାରୁ ୟୁପିଆଇ (UPI) ମାଧ୍ୟମରେ ଟଙ୍କା କଟିଯାଇଛି କିନ୍ତୁ କାରବାର ବିଫଳ (failed) ହୋଇଛି, ତେବେ ଭାରତୀୟ ରିଜର୍ଭ ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କ (RBI) ଏବଂ NPCI ର ନିୟମ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ ୨୪ ରୁ ୪୮ ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କିଙ୍ଗ୍ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟଦିବସ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଟଙ୍କା ସ୍ୱୟଂଚାଳିତ ଭାବରେ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ମୂଳ ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କ ଖାତାକୁ ଫେରସ୍ତ (Auto-Refund) ଆସିଥାଏ। ଆପଣ ନିଜ ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କ ଷ୍ଟେଟମେଣ୍ଟ କିମ୍ବା ୟୁପିଆଇ ଆପ୍‌ରୁ ୧୨ ଅଙ୍କ ବିଶିଷ୍ଟ ୟୁଟିଆର୍ (UTR) ନମ୍ବର ସାହାଯ୍ୟରେ ରିଫଣ୍ଡ ସ୍ଥିତି ଯାଞ୍ଚ କରିପାରିବେ।
